context.text: either outside or the treadmill in my building's gym, depends on the weather
Got it. Do you track your runs with anything?
my apple watch tracks it all
Nice, the watch makes proof easy. Anything you're working toward, like a distance or a race?

transcript.text: not really, just want more stamina

Stamina is a great reason to run, Taylor, and the watch makes this simple. Here's the plan:
• Headed for: more stamina
• Day 1, today at 6 pm: 20 min easy run, 2 min jog and 1 min walk on repeat, at a pace where you could still talk
• Where: outside, or your building's treadmill if the weather's bad
• Schedule: Mon, Wed, Fri at 6 pm. The rest days are when your legs get stronger.
• Proof: a screenshot of your Apple Watch workout summary. If that's a hassle, a photo of the watch screen works too.

Each run shapes the next one, and we'll stretch the jog parts as you get stronger. What do you think?

Treadmill it is, Taylor. Rain won't get you out of day 1 😄 Today's run is the 2 min jog and 1 min walk loop for 20 minutes at 6 pm, then a screenshot of your watch summary. Are you committing to this plan, Mon, Wed, Fri at 6?
Glad it fits, Taylor. Are you officially in on this one: Mon, Wed, Fri at 6 pm, starting today?
